definition: The main product itself - total volume produced. Not waste.
notes: Context / denominator only; generally excluded from BioMobi's sidestream focus.

definition: Residual stream where the source does NOT split edible vs inedible = the total.
notes: = nevenstroom + voedselverlies. If assigned only because the source gave no edible/inedible detail, set type_assumed = TRUE.

definition: The inedible by-product: peels, leaves, stems, bones, etc.
Edible food that is lost or discarded.

notes: Merged into agri-food waste: in BioMobi's food-biomass scope it is not distinct from voedselreststroom.

maps_to: agri-food waste (or nevenstroom/voedselverlies if the source specifies)
notes: chain_L2 = Voedingsindustrie. Keep the word in source_type_label; if defaulted for lack of detail, type_assumed = TRUE.

maps_to: agri-food waste (or voedselverlies if the source specifies)
definition: (retired) Produce withdrawn from the market at auction.
notes: chain_L2 = Producentenorganisaties/veilingen. Keep the word in source_type_label.

definition: (retired) Final food waste at the retail / consumer end.
notes: chain_L2 = Retail & grootdistributie or Horeca & catering. Keep the word in source_type_label.

definition: (MONBIO term, added 2026-08-16) Comparable to a nevenstroom but without economic value, with or without waste status.
notes: MONBIO (S005/S006/S007/S091) splits its residual streams into 'nevenstromen' and 'productieresiduen' on an ECONOMIC axis (has value / has none), not on the register's edible/inedible axis. Neither term can therefore be mapped to the register's nevenstroom. Session decision 2026-08-16: BOTH MONBIO terms map to agri-food waste with type_assumed = TRUE, keeping the source's own word in source_type_label.

definition: (MONBIO term, added 2026-08-16) A stream with economic value that is not the primary objective of production.
notes: NOT the register's 'nevenstroom' - see the productieresidu row above. Maps to agri-food waste, type_assumed = TRUE.

definition: (out of scope) A processed product derived from a residual (diermeel, dierlijke vetten, ...).
notes: Not a raw sidestream - excluded from BioMobi.

definition: (out of scope) Surplus food redirected as donation.
notes: Goes to human consumption - not available biomass.
